newsitem.title: SPAIN: EIB 40 bln pta 10-year Bonos available from Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: EIB 40 bln pta 10-year Bonos available from Oct 28.

text.p: The European Investment Bank's 10-year bond will be available to investors in Spain between Monday October 28 and Friday November 15, an EIB note said on Monday.
The 40 billion peseta seven-percent matador bond was announced on October 14 by global coordinator and issue manager Caja de Madrid.
Banco Santander and Banco Central Hispano are taking part as co-directors, while some 20 savings and commercial banks are taking part in the placement.

The bonds are aimed particularly at small investors and are called Bonos Europeos. The seven percent coupon is paid semi-annually and is equivalent to 7.12 percent annually. The price is at par and the denomination is 10,000 pesetas.
